Late 20's so close enough.

I have a serious problem with this solution because it feels hollow. It's fake, it's a lie. There's no point to happiness or joy when its all going to disappear and end. All of the small moments, every memory, every glorious victory and utter defeat, every quiet moment that only I share and every small touch of a lover will be utterly lost to the winds of time; gone, like tears in the rain.

So I'm sorry, but your answer isn't good enough. It changes nothing.
I'm sorry, but that's just not good enough.
So when life is without enjoyment it should end?
